verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for a payments platform that stores payment and merchant data. The pack contains no documented retention settings, retention periods, or deletion endpoints. The closest item says platforms own their data and can export it, which is adjacent (ownership and export, not retention or deletion control), and the 24-hour session lifetime concerns credentials, not data retention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
